Chapter 1263: 19: The World Of 10 Billion Particles (Subscribe)

Chapter 1263: Chapter 19: The World of 10 Billion Particles (Subscribe)

Qingyun Sacred Mountain stands tall as the old lair of the Qingyun Saint Sect, the top hegemonic force before the great changes in heaven and earth.

Inside Qingyun Sacred Mountain, numerous small worlds have been opened up.

They serve to cultivate fresh blood for the Holy Sect.

Thus, despite much of the external world being occupied by ‘demons’, it has managed to persist until now.

At the Qingyuan Academy, Lin Yuan hasn’t changed much compared to a thousand years ago, except that his aura has become much more restrained.

“Steward Chen, they say ‘demons’ are immortal. Is there really no way to completely eradicate them?”

A young disciple, having just exchanged the jade scrolls he needed, couldn’t help but inquire as he looked at Lin Yuan.

For a millennium, Lin Yuan had been living in seclusion at Qingyuan Academy, occasionally offering guidance to newly admitted disciples. Over time, he gained quite a reputation, and many disciples were happy to consult him.

“Demons originate from the Demonic Qi of heaven and earth. If the Demonic Qi is not destroyed, then demons too will not be destroyed.” Lin Yuan calmly said: “To completely wipe out the demons of this world, one must erase the source of the Demonic Qi.”

The so-called source of the Demonic Qi is the legendary Demon God.

Having arrived in this Fang Yuan World for a millennium, Lin Yuan had learned many hidden truths.

For example, if Demonic Qi were likened to sunlight, then the Demon God would be the sun.

As long as the sun exists, Demonic Qi will flow ceaselessly. Even if a terrifying demon is completely annihilated, it will be reborn under the endless Demonic Qi.

“How can one erase the source of the Demonic Qi?”

The young disciple continued to inquire.

“I don’t know either.”

Lin Yuan shook his head. Although he sensed all Demonic Qi originated from the Demon God,

he did not know the whereabouts of the Demon God.

In fact, even if he knew, he wouldn’t attempt to erase it, given that the Demon God’s power capable of causing a world-spanning disaster surely matches at least the thirteenth-tier level.

“Alright, there’s no need for you to think too much.” Lin Yuan glanced at the worried young disciple and said offhandedly.

“Mm.”

The young disciple nodded and immediately left Qingyuan Academy.

Just as he reached the entrance of Qingyun Institute, several other young disciples gathered around.

“Ouyang, what did you discuss with Steward Chen?” The curious young disciples asked.

“I asked how to completely eradicate the external ‘demons’.” The young disciple named Ouyang replied truthfully.

“What did Steward Chen say?”

“Steward Chen said to defeat demons, you must erase the source of the Demonic Qi.”

Ouyang said.

“Erase the source of the Demonic Qi?”

The group of young disciples pondered deeply for a moment.

They did not doubt the answer given by Lin Yuan. Over the millennium, although Steward Chen from Qingyuan Academy never displayed any power or skills, he was perceptive and well-informed, to the extent that even elders from the Holy Sect would occasionally seek his counsel.

“Ah, given Steward Chen’s understanding of ‘demons’, why does he stay in Qingyuan Academy? Wouldn’t it be better to go beyond and clear the gathering points of Demonic Qi?”

“It’s said that a thousand years ago, during an operation to clear a gathering point of Demonic Qi, Steward Chen was corrupted by it, leaving certain hidden concerns.”

“I see. Steward Chen has truly made such great contributions to our Holy Sect!”

The young disciples showed great respect.

Being corrupted by the Demonic Qi has severe consequences, and few survive.

…

Deep within Qingyuan Academy, Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

“The waters of this Fang Yuan World run deep, for those eternal sects in the central realms surely have time and life on their side, yet they allow Demonic Qi to permeate. What is the real reason behind this?”

Lin Yuan’s expression became slightly solemn. This was also the reason that eight hundred years ago, after regaining peak strength, he continued to hide in Qingyun Sacred Mountain.

Unable to understand the details of the external world.

And hiding in Qingyun Sacred Mountain did not hinder Lin Yuan’s cultivation and enlightenment.

The Qingyun Saint Sect’s collection of rune inheritance was vast enough for Lin Yuan to study for hundreds or even thousands of years.

Additionally, Lin Yuan needed a considerable amount of time to slowly develop his own particle worlds. Coupled with the pervasive Demonic Qi outside, where ‘demons’ lurked everywhere, whenever Lin Yuan was in need of resources, he would go out, and would almost always return with plentiful gains.

For the cultivators of this world, every ‘demon’ is terrifying beyond measure, but in Lin Yuan’s eyes, so-called ‘demons’ are just fledglings. Even for those as strong as the great demons, Lin Yuan could effortlessly subdue and then quickly refine them.

If not for the fear of the Demon God, he would have long ventured to the central realms to hunt those Source Demons.

“A thousand years of cultivation, the Chaos Yin Yang Taiji Dao has reached the peak of the first level. In a short few hundred years to a long few thousand years, it could step into the second level.”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face. The Chaos Yin Yang Taiji Dao is his foundation. Even the means he uses now to refine terrifying ‘demons’ rely on the Chaos Yin Yang Taiji Power.

The stronger the Chaos Yin Yang Taiji Dao, the greater the assistance to Lin Yuan. This kind of support is fundamental, nurturing everything about himself via the great Dao he follows—his body, soul, mind, will, and so forth.

“And the thirteenth-tier inheritance of the ‘Infinite Void’…”

This lineage, honed through a millennium of cultivation, has also advanced halfway through the fourth level.

…

A millennium of cultivation has led Lin Yuan to make substantial progress in all aspects, especially after understanding the rune inheritance from the second source world, which greatly aided him in comprehending many rules and great Dao.

Of course, among all his gains, the biggest is still the development of particle worlds.

By using the Rune Dao to stabilize every particle world, and with the inexhaustible ‘demons’ of this source world,

Lin Yuan has now developed one billion particle worlds.

One billion particle worlds.

Though there is still a distance to his ultimate goal of the Constant Sand Particle World,

the support of one billion particle worlds to Lin Yuan is indeed formidable.
